vr1022100.title: SMISKI Strap Accessories Series 4 Assort Box 24 Blind Capsules Glow in the Dark
vr1022100.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1022100.details: SMISKI Strap Accessories Series 4 assort box by Dreams, a set of 24 blind capsules, Japanese version, brand new and unopened. Each capsule holds one mini glow-in-the-dark Smiski strap from 6 designs plus 1 secret design, and which one is inside is a surprise until you open it. A 24-capsule box does not always contain every design, and the secret is not always included. The capsules and the figures use a glow-in-the-dark material that shines in the dark, and each figure comes with a strap. The photos are product images; you will receive the 24 capsules.
